name: Top Class Education For Scheduled Caste Students
benefit:
1. Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges shall be paid.
1. For private sector institutions, the fee support is subject to a ceiling of ₹2,00,000 per annum per student.
1. Academic Allowance:

  - ₹86,000 in the first year.
  - ₹41,000 in each subsequent year.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should have secured admission to a notified institution identified under the scheme. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a course beyond Class 12 in a notified institution. 1. The applicant's total annual family income from all sources should not exceed ₹8,00,000. 1. The applicant should be admitted through the prescribed admission process and satisfy the merit requirements applicable to the institution/course. 1. The applicant should be a first-year student of the approved course for consideration under the fresh scholarship category. > **Reservation:** - 30% of the scholarship slots are reserved for eligible Scheduled Caste girl students. - Unutilized slots reserved for girls may be transferred to eligible male students.
